hero.title: The Polygood® Project Edit
hero.subtitle: Explore the projects, discover the patterns behind them, and find something for your next material palette.
hero.intro: This autumn, we’re back with a fresh selection of Polygood® projects to share with you. We’ve brought together four different takes on the material, from sculptural furniture to thoughtfully detailed interiors.

headline: Seven patterns in four cities
umbrella_statement: Under each project you'll find its swatches, named as you'd order them: the Amsterdam plinths are Salmon Terra, PS2121.
intro:
In the projects below, Polygood was used for display plinths in an Amsterdam department store, washstands in a Vienna hotel, kitchenette worktops in a Paris office and furniture made by a Taipei design studio.

One pattern, Emerald Ghost, appears in three of them: on the hotel's washstands, on the office worktops and among the studio's pieces.

cases.title: De Bijenkorf
cases.headline: On Dam Square, Salmon Terra plinths lift mannequins
cases.body:
De Bijenkorf reopened the women's fashion and shoe department of its Dam Square flagship in 2026, with sustainability in the brief from the first meeting. The store first used Polygood in 2023, for retail fixtures, and chose it again. We made the display stands in Salmon Terra: stepped plinths and blocks that lift mannequins and bags above the shop floor. The design is by Random Studio with the store's own design team, and Fiction Factory built the stands.

When the displays change, the stands can come back through our take-back programme and become new panels.
cases.image_alt: Display stands in the Salmon Terra pattern at De Bijenkorf Amsterdam

cases.title: Henriette Stadthotel
cases.headline: Washstands in two terrazzos and Emerald Ghost
cases.body:
In 2025 Verena Brandtner-Pastuszyn and Georg Pastuszyn renovated their family-run four-star hotel on Praterstraße, a short walk from the Prater. They call it Austria's first Circular Living hotel, a concept inspired by Cradle to Cradle.

For the new Circular Living rooms we made the bathroom washstands in Sapphire Terrazzo, Emerald Ghost and White Terrazzo. The washstand pictured is in Sapphire Terrazzo, with a white basin.
cases.pattern: Sapphire Terrazzo, Emerald Ghost, White Terrazzo
cases.image_alt: Washstand in Sapphire Terrazzo with a white basin in a guest bathroom at Henriette Stadthotel, Vienna

cases.title: Orion
cases.headline: Sea-green worktops a shade lighter than teal cabinets
cases.body: Aura designed the teal kitchenette where Orion's Paris team meets through the day. A white stone or wood top would have cut a line through the teal. The worktops on the island and back counter are Emerald Ghost, a flecked sea green a shade lighter than the cabinets, so the island and counters read as one block of colour. The flecks give the monochrome scheme depth and pick up the speckled stools. Samji Studio, a Paris office-furniture workshop, fabricated the worktops and cut the island top to follow its rounded end.
cases.image_alt: Kitchenette worktop in the Emerald Ghost pattern at the Orion office in Paris

cases.title: ONE DUST Studio
cases.headline: Surface specialists made furniture and sculpture in Polygood
cases.body:
For our first project in Taiwan we worked with ONE DUST, a Taipei design studio that makes installation art and decorative finishes, including mineral wall coatings. Polygood can be cut, sanded and polished like a solid surface. The studio designed and made tables, chairs, benches, shelves and sculptural objects in five patterns: Maldives, Black Lollipop, Emerald Ghost, Sapphire Terrazzo and Translucent Glitter Gold, which no other project has used so far.

Indoors, the colours sit against the studio's own mineral finishes on walls and floors. Outdoors, in a gravel garden backed by forest, a translucent blue slab lets the trees show through.
